allow: PowerShell($p = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/portfolio" -UseBasicParsing; $p.StatusCode; $bad = try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/quotes" -Method Post -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{}' -UseBasicParsing } catch { $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__ }; $bad)

PowerShell($deadline = \(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(15\); $ok = $false; while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline\) { try { $p = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing; if \($p.StatusCode -eq 200\) { $ok = $true; break } } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }; if \($ok\) { "server up: 200" } else { "server not responding" })

PowerShell($deadline = \(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(20\); while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline\) { try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/quotes" -Method Post -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{"items":[{"ticker":"005930","market":"KR"}]}'; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } }; "삼성전자 현재가: $\($r.quotes.'KR:005930'.price\) \(변동 $\($r.quotes.'KR:005930'.change\), $\($r.quotes.'KR:005930'.changePct\)%\)")

PowerShell($r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/candles?kind=index&market=KR&code=0001&period=D"; "코스피 일봉 $\($r.candles.Count\)개, 마지막 종가: $\($r.candles[-1].close\) \(mock이면 2700\)"; $r2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/candles?kind=stock&market=US&code=AAPL&period=D"; "AAPL 일봉 $\($r2.candles.Count\)개, 마지막 종가: $\($r2.candles[-1].close\) \(mock이면 295.3\)"; $r3 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/candles?kind=index&market=US&code=SPX&period=D"; "S&P500 일봉 $\($r3.candles.Count\)개, 마지막 종가: $\($r3.candles[-1].close\) \(mock이면 5600\)")

PowerShell($json = '{"items":[{"ticker":"005930","market":"KR","name":"Samsung"},{"ticker":"AAPL","market":"US","name":"Apple"}]}'; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/fundamentals" -Method Post -ContentType "application/json" -Body $json; "삼성전자 PER $\($r.fundamentals.'KR:005930'.per\) / PBR $\($r.fundamentals.'KR:005930'.pbr\) / 시총 $\($r.fundamentals.'KR:005930'.marketCap\)억 \(mock이면 PER 9.65\)"; "AAPL PER $\($r.fundamentals.'US:AAPL'.per\) \(Finnhub 키 없음 → mock 30.86이어야 정상\)")
